   207	void initializeLocalGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const Partition& xPart,
   208	                         const Partition& yPart, const Partition& zPart,
   209	                         const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
   210	    const size_t sx = xPart.count + 2;
   211	    const size_t sy = yPart.count + 2;
   212	    const size_t sz = zPart.count + 2;
   213	    const size_t globalPlane = nx * ny;
   214	    for (size_t z = 0; z < sz; ++z) {
   215	        const size_t gz = zPart.begin + z - 1;
   216	        for (size_t y = 0; y < sy; ++y) {
   217	            const size_t gy = yPart.begin + y - 1;
   218	            for (size_t x = 0; x < sx; ++x) {
   219	                const size_t gx = xPart.begin + x - 1;
   220	                const size_t globalIndex = gz * globalPlane + gy * nx + gx;
   220	                const size_t globalIndex = gz * globalPlane + gy * nx + gx;
   221	                grid[idx3(x, y, z, sx, sy)] = static_cast<Real>(globalIndex % 19);
   222	            }
   223	        }
   224	    }
   225	}

   262	class PersistentHaloExchange {
   263	  public:
   264	    PersistentHaloExchange(Real* data, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
   265	                           const size_t lz, const FaceTypes& faces,
   266	                           const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors, MPI_Comm comm) {
   267	        const size_t sx = lx + 2;
   268	        const size_t sy = ly + 2;
   269	        const auto at = [sx, sy](const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {
   270	            return idx3(x, y, z, sx, sy);
   271	        };
   272	        const auto receive = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
   273	                                 const int neighbor, const int tag) {
   274	            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   275	                MPI_Recv_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
   276	                              &receives_[receiveCount_++]);
   277	            }
   278	        };
   279	        const auto send = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
   280	                              const int neighbor, const int tag) {
   281	            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   282	                MPI_Send_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
   283	                              &sends_[sendCount_++]);
   284	            }
   285	        };
   286	
   287	        // Receive requests are kept separate so computation can resume as soon
   288	        // as incoming halos arrive, without waiting for outgoing sends.
   289	        receive(data + at(0, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_PLUS);
   290	        receive(data + at(lx + 1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_MINUS);
   291	        receive(data + at(1, 0, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_PLUS);
   292	        receive(data + at(1, ly + 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_MINUS);
   293	        receive(data + at(1, 1, 0), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_PLUS);
   294	        receive(data + at(1, 1, lz + 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_MINUS);
   295	
   296	        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_MINUS);
   297	        send(data + at(lx, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_PLUS);
   298	        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_MINUS);
   299	        send(data + at(1, ly, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_PLUS);
   300	        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_MINUS);
   301	        send(data + at(1, 1, lz), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_PLUS);
   302	    }
   303	
   304	    PersistentHaloExchange(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
   305	    PersistentHaloExchange& operator=(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
   306	
   307	    ~PersistentHaloExchange() {
   308	        for (int i = 0; i < receiveCount_; ++i) {
   309	            MPI_Request_free(&receives_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
   310	        }
   311	        for (int i = 0; i < sendCount_; ++i) {
   312	            MPI_Request_free(&sends_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
   313	        }
   314	    }
   315	
   316	    void start() {
   317	        if (receiveCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(receiveCount_, receives_.data());
   318	        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(sendCount_, sends_.data());
   319	    }
   320	
   321	    void waitForReceives() {
   322	        if (receiveCount_ != 0) {
   323	            MPI_Waitall(receiveCount_, receives_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
   324	        }
   325	    }
   326	
   327	    void waitForSends() {
   328	        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Waitall(sendCount_, sends_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
   329	    }
   330	
   331	  private:
   332	    static constexpr int X_TO_MINUS = 10;
   333	    static constexpr int X_TO_PLUS = 11;
   334	    static constexpr int Y_TO_MINUS = 12;
   335	    static constexpr int Y_TO_PLUS = 13;
   336	    static constexpr int Z_TO_MINUS = 14;
   337	    static constexpr int Z_TO_PLUS = 15;
   338	
   339	    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> receives_{};
   340	    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> sends_{};
   341	    int receiveCount_ = 0;
   342	    int sendCount_ = 0;
   343	};

   345	inline void computeBlock(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
   346	                         Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t sx,
   347	                         const size_t sy, const size_t xBegin, const size_t xEnd,
   348	                         const size_t yBegin, const size_t yEnd,
   349	                         const size_t zBegin, const size_t zEnd) {
   350	    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) return;
   351	    const size_t plane = sx * sy;
   352	    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
   353	        for (size_t y = yBegin; y < yEnd; ++y) {
   354	            const size_t rowStart = idx3(xBegin, y, z, sx, sy);
   355	            const size_t rowEnd = rowStart + (xEnd - xBegin);
   356	#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
   357	#pragma GCC ivdep
   358	#endif
   359	            for (size_t i = rowStart; i < rowEnd; ++i) {
   360	                output[i] = (input[i] + input[i - 1] + input[i + 1] +
   361	                             input[i - sx] + input[i + sx] + input[i - plane] +
   362	                             input[i + plane]) /
   363	                            7.0;
   364	            }
   365	        }
   366	    }
   367	}

   369	// Compute the complement of an already-computed rectangular core. The six
   370	// blocks are disjoint. On ranks at a physical boundary, the core extends to
   371	// that boundary because its fixed halo is already available.
   372	void computeCoreComplement(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
   373	                           Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t lx,
   374	                           const size_t ly, const size_t lz, const size_t xBegin,
   375	                           const size_t xEnd, const size_t yBegin,
   376	                           const size_t yEnd, const size_t zBegin,
   377	                           const size_t zEnd) {
   378	    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
   379	    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
   380	    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) {
   381	        computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, lz + 1);
   382	        return;
   383	    }
   384	
   385	    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, zBegin);
   386	    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, zEnd, lz + 1);
   387	    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, yBegin, zBegin, zEnd);
   388	    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, yEnd, ly + 1, zBegin, zEnd);
   389	    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, xBegin, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
   390	    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, xEnd, lx + 1, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
   391	}

   393	void exchangeAndCompute(PersistentHaloExchange& exchange, const Real* input,
   394	                        Real* output, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
   395	                        const size_t lz, const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors) {
   396	    const size_t xBegin = neighbors[0] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
   397	    const size_t xEnd = neighbors[1] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lx + 1 : lx;
   398	    const size_t yBegin = neighbors[2] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
   399	    const size_t yEnd = neighbors[3] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? ly + 1 : ly;
   400	    const size_t zBegin = neighbors[4] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
   401	    const size_t zEnd = neighbors[5] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lz + 1 : lz;
   402	
   403	    exchange.start();
   404	    // This region has no halo dependency and overlaps network progress.
   405	    computeBlock(input, output, lx + 2, ly + 2, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
   406	                 zBegin, zEnd);
   407	    exchange.waitForReceives();
   408	    computeCoreComplement(input, output, lx, ly, lz, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
   409	                          zBegin, zEnd);
   410	    exchange.waitForSends();
   411	}

   413	void sendLarge(const Real* data, size_t count, const int destination, MPI_Comm comm) {
   414	    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
   415	    while (count != 0) {
   416	        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
   417	        MPI_Send(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, destination, 90, comm);
   418	        data += chunk;
   419	        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
   420	    }
   421	}

   584	int runActiveBenchmark(const Options& options, const ProcessGrid& processGrid,
   585	                       MPI_Comm activeComm) {
   586	    const std::array<int, 3> periods{0, 0, 0};
   587	    MPI_Comm cartComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   588	    MPI_Cart_create(activeComm, 3, processGrid.dims.data(), periods.data(), 0,
   589	                    &cartComm);
   590	
   591	    int cartRank = 0;
   592	    int cartSize = 1;
   593	    MPI_Comm_rank(cartComm, &cartRank);
   594	    MPI_Comm_size(cartComm, &cartSize);
   595	    std::array<int, 3> coords{};
   596	    MPI_Cart_coords(cartComm, cartRank, 3, coords.data());
   597	
   598	    const Partition xp = makePartition(options.nx - 2, coords[0], processGrid.dims[0]);
   599	    const Partition yp = makePartition(options.ny - 2, coords[1], processGrid.dims[1]);
   600	    const Partition zp = makePartition(options.nz - 2, coords[2], processGrid.dims[2]);
   601	    const size_t lx = xp.count;
   602	    const size_t ly = yp.count;
   603	    const size_t lz = zp.count;
   604	
   605	    std::array<int, 6> neighbors{};
   606	    MPI_Cart_shift(cartComm, 0, 1, &neighbors[0], &neighbors[1]);
   607	    MPI_Cart_shift(cartComm, 1, 1, &neighbors[2], &neighbors[3]);
   608	    MPI_Cart_shift(cartComm, 2, 1, &neighbors[4], &neighbors[5]);
   609	
   610	    if (cartRank == 0) {
   611	        std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
   612	        std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", options.nx, options.ny, options.nz);
   613	        std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", options.iterations);
   614	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", options.validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   615	        std::printf("MPI ranks: %d (Cartesian grid: %d x %d x %d)\n", cartSize,
   616	                    processGrid.dims[0], processGrid.dims[1], processGrid.dims[2]);
   617	        std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
   618	    }
   619	
   620	    size_t localXY = 0;
   621	    size_t localSize = 0;
   622	    if (!checkedProduct(lx + 2, ly + 2, localXY) ||
   623	        !checkedProduct(localXY, lz + 2, localSize)) {
   624	        if (cartRank == 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "Local grid size overflow\n");
   625	        MPI_Abort(cartComm, 1);
   626	    }
   627	
   628	    int exitCode = 0;
   629	    {
   630	        std::vector<Real> grid1(localSize);
   631	        std::vector<Real> grid2(localSize);
   632	        initializeLocalGrid(grid1, xp, yp, zp, options.nx, options.ny);
   633	        initializeLocalGrid(grid2, xp, yp, zp, options.nx, options.ny);
   634	
   635	        FaceTypes faceTypes(lx, ly, lz);
   636	        PersistentHaloExchange exchange1(grid1.data(), lx, ly, lz, faceTypes,
   637	                                         neighbors, cartComm);
   638	        PersistentHaloExchange exchange2(grid2.data(), lx, ly, lz, faceTypes,
   639	                                         neighbors, cartComm);
   640	
   641	        Real* current = grid1.data();
   642	        Real* next = grid2.data();
   643	        PersistentHaloExchange* currentExchange = &exchange1;
   644	        PersistentHaloExchange* nextExchange = &exchange2;
   645	
   646	        if (cartRank == 0) std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
   647	        MPI_Barrier(cartComm);
   648	        const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   649	        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < options.iterations; ++iteration) {
   650	            exchangeAndCompute(*currentExchange, current, next, lx, ly, lz,
   651	                               neighbors);
   652	            std::swap(current, next);
   653	            std::swap(currentExchange, nextExchange);
   654	        }
   655	        const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   656	        double elapsed = 0.0;
   657	        MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, cartComm);
   658	
   659	        if (cartRank == 0) {
   660	            const auto milliseconds = static_cast<long long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
   661	            const double updates = static_cast<double>(options.nx - 2) *
   662	                                   static_cast<double>(options.ny - 2) *
   663	                                   static_cast<double>(options.nz - 2) *
   664	                                   static_cast<double>(options.iterations);
   665	            const double mcups = updates / elapsed / 1.0e6;
   666	            std::printf("Computation time: %lld ms\n", milliseconds);
   667	            std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   668	        }
   669	
   670	        std::vector<Real> globalResult;
   671	        if (options.printResults) {
   672	            globalResult = gatherGlobalGrid(current, xp, yp, zp, options.nx,
   673	                                            options.ny, options.nz, processGrid.dims,
   674	                                            cartRank, cartSize, cartComm);
   675	            if (cartRank == 0) print_results(globalResult, "Grid");
   676	        }
   677	
   678	        if (options.validate) {
   679	            if (cartRank == 0) std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   680	            bool valid = true;
   681	            if (options.printResults) {
   682	                int validInteger = 1;
   683	                if (cartRank == 0) validInteger = validateResult(globalResult) ? 1 : 0;
   684	                MPI_Bcast(&validInteger, 1, MPI_INT, 0, cartComm);
   685	                valid = validInteger != 0;
   686	            } else {
   687	                valid = validateDistributed(current, xp, yp, zp, options.nx,
   688	                                            options.ny, options.nz, cartRank, cartComm);
   689	            }
   690	            if (cartRank == 0) {
   691	                std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   692	            }
   693	            exitCode = valid ? 0 : 1;
   694	        }
   695	    }
   696	
   697	    MPI_Comm_free(&cartComm);
   698	    return exitCode;
   699	}

   702	    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);
   703

   705	    int worldSize = 1;
   706	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);
   707	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);
   708	
   709	    Options options;
   710	    const int parseStatus = parseArguments(argc, argv, options, worldRank == 0);
   711	    if (parseStatus != 0) {
   712	        MPI_Finalize();
   713	        return parseStatus == 2 ? 0 : 1;
   714	    }
   715	
   716	    size_t xy = 0;
   717	    size_t gridSize = 0;
   718	    const bool validDimensions = options.nx >= 3 && options.ny >= 3 && options.nz >= 3 &&
   719	        options.nx <= static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX - 2) &&
   720	        options.ny <= static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX - 2) &&
   721	        options.nz <= static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX - 2) &&
   722	        checkedProduct(options.nx, options.ny, xy) &&
   723	        checkedProduct(xy, options.nz, gridSize);
   724	    if (!validDimensions) {
   725	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   726	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   727	                         "Grid dimensions must each be at least 3, fit MPI datatype "
   728	                         "limits, and have a representable total size.\n");
   729	        }
   730	        MPI_Finalize();
   731	        return 1;
   732	    }
   733	
   734	    const ProcessGrid processGrid =
   735	        chooseProcessGrid(worldSize, options.nx - 2, options.ny - 2, options.nz - 2);
   736	    if (worldRank == 0 && processGrid.activeRanks != worldSize) {
   737	        std::fprintf(stderr,
   738	                     "Warning: using %d of %d MPI ranks because the interior grid "
   739	                     "cannot be partitioned into more nonempty Cartesian blocks.\n",
   740	                     processGrid.activeRanks, worldSize);
   741	    }
   742	
   743	    MPI_Comm activeComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   744	    MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   745	                   worldRank < processGrid.activeRanks ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED,
   746	                   worldRank, &activeComm);
   747	
   748	    int exitCode = 0;
   749	    if (activeComm != MPI_COMM_NULL) {
   750	        exitCode = runActiveBenchmark(options, processGrid, activeComm);
   751	        MPI_Comm_free(&activeComm);
   752	    }
   753	
   754	    // Inactive excess ranks wait here and receive the root's final status.
   755	    MPI_Bcast(&exitCode, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   756	    MPI_Finalize();
   757	    return exitCode;

+size_t ceilDivide(const size_t value, const int parts) {
+    return value / static_cast<size_t>(parts) +
+           (value % static_cast<size_t>(parts) != 0 ? 1 : 0);

+// Pick the largest usable Cartesian grid, then favor balanced work and small
+// halo surfaces. Unlike MPI_Dims_create, this also respects anisotropic grids
+// and never creates an empty subdomain.
+ProcessGrid chooseProcessGrid(const int worldSize, const size_t ix,
+                              const size_t iy, const size_t iz) {
+    const size_t interiorCells = ix * iy * iz;
+    const int maximumRanks = interiorCells < static_cast<size_t>(worldSize)
+                                 ? static_cast<int>(interiorCells)
+                                 : worldSize;
+    for (int ranks = maximumRanks; ranks >= 1; --ranks) {
+        bool found = false;
+        std::array<int, 3> best{1, 1, 1};
+        size_t bestMaxCells = std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max();
+        long double bestSurface = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
+        long double bestTotalSurface = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
+
+        for (int px = 1; px <= ranks; ++px) {
+            if (ranks % px != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(px) > ix) continue;
+            const int yz = ranks / px;
+            for (int py = 1; py <= yz; ++py) {
+                if (yz % py != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(py) > iy) continue;
+                const int pz = yz / py;
+                if (static_cast<size_t>(pz) > iz) continue;
+
+                const size_t maxX = ceilDivide(ix, px);
+                const size_t maxY = ceilDivide(iy, py);
+                const size_t maxZ = ceilDivide(iz, pz);
+                const size_t maxCells = maxX * maxY * maxZ;
+                const long double surface =
+                    (px > 1 ? 2.0L * maxY * maxZ : 0.0L) +
+                    (py > 1 ? 2.0L * maxX * maxZ : 0.0L) +
+                    (pz > 1 ? 2.0L * maxX * maxY : 0.0L);
+                const long double totalSurface =
+                    static_cast<long double>(px - 1) * iy * iz +
+                    static_cast<long double>(py - 1) * ix * iz +
+                    static_cast<long double>(pz - 1) * ix * iy;
+
+                if (!found || maxCells < bestMaxCells ||
+                    (maxCells == bestMaxCells && surface < bestSurface) ||
+                    (maxCells == bestMaxCells && surface == bestSurface &&
+                     totalSurface < bestTotalSurface)) {
+                    found = true;
+                    best = {px, py, pz};
+                    bestMaxCells = maxCells;
+                    bestSurface = surface;
+                    bestTotalSurface = totalSurface;
+                }
             }
         }
+        if (found) return {ranks, best};

+Partition makePartition(const size_t interiorExtent, const int coordinate,
+                        const int processes) {
+    const size_t base = interiorExtent / static_cast<size_t>(processes);
+    const size_t remainder = interiorExtent % static_cast<size_t>(processes);
+    const size_t coord = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    const size_t count = base + (coord < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const size_t offset = coord * base + std::min(coord, remainder);
+    return {offset + 1, count};

+class PersistentHaloExchange {
+  public:
+    PersistentHaloExchange(Real* data, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                           const size_t lz, const FaceTypes& faces,
+                           const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors, MPI_Comm comm) {
+        const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+        const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+        const auto at = [sx, sy](const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {
+            return idx3(x, y, z, sx, sy);
+        };
+        const auto receive = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
+                                 const int neighbor, const int tag) {
+            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_Recv_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
+                              &receives_[receiveCount_++]);
+            }
+        };
+        const auto send = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
+                              const int neighbor, const int tag) {
+            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_Send_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
+                              &sends_[sendCount_++]);
+            }
+        };
+
+        // Receive requests are kept separate so computation can resume as soon
+        // as incoming halos arrive, without waiting for outgoing sends.
+        receive(data + at(0, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(lx + 1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_MINUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 0, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, ly + 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_MINUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 1, 0), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 1, lz + 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_MINUS);
+
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(lx, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_PLUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(1, ly, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_PLUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, lz), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_PLUS);
+    }
+
+    PersistentHaloExchange(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
+    PersistentHaloExchange& operator=(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
+
+    ~PersistentHaloExchange() {
+        for (int i = 0; i < receiveCount_; ++i) {
+            MPI_Request_free(&receives_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
+        }
+        for (int i = 0; i < sendCount_; ++i) {
+            MPI_Request_free(&sends_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void start() {
+        if (receiveCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(receiveCount_, receives_.data());
+        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(sendCount_, sends_.data());
+    }
+
+    void waitForReceives() {
+        if (receiveCount_ != 0) {
+            MPI_Waitall(receiveCount_, receives_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void waitForSends() {
+        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Waitall(sendCount_, sends_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+
+  private:
+    static constexpr int X_TO_MINUS = 10;
+    static constexpr int X_TO_PLUS = 11;
+    static constexpr int Y_TO_MINUS = 12;
+    static constexpr int Y_TO_PLUS = 13;
+    static constexpr int Z_TO_MINUS = 14;
+    static constexpr int Z_TO_PLUS = 15;
+
+    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> receives_{};
+    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> sends_{};
+    int receiveCount_ = 0;
+    int sendCount_ = 0;
+};

+inline void computeBlock(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
+                         Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t sx,
+                         const size_t sy, const size_t xBegin, const size_t xEnd,
+                         const size_t yBegin, const size_t yEnd,
+                         const size_t zBegin, const size_t zEnd) {
+    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) return;
+    const size_t plane = sx * sy;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        for (size_t y = yBegin; y < yEnd; ++y) {
+            const size_t rowStart = idx3(xBegin, y, z, sx, sy);
+            const size_t rowEnd = rowStart + (xEnd - xBegin);
+#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
+#pragma GCC ivdep
+#endif
+            for (size_t i = rowStart; i < rowEnd; ++i) {
+                output[i] = (input[i] + input[i - 1] + input[i + 1] +
+                             input[i - sx] + input[i + sx] + input[i - plane] +
+                             input[i + plane]) /
+                            7.0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Compute the complement of an already-computed rectangular core. The six
+// blocks are disjoint. On ranks at a physical boundary, the core extends to
+// that boundary because its fixed halo is already available.
+void computeCoreComplement(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
+                           Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t lx,
+                           const size_t ly, const size_t lz, const size_t xBegin,
+                           const size_t xEnd, const size_t yBegin,
+                           const size_t yEnd, const size_t zBegin,
+                           const size_t zEnd) {
+    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, lz + 1);
+        return;
+    }
+
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, zBegin);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, zEnd, lz + 1);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, yBegin, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, yEnd, ly + 1, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, xBegin, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, xEnd, lx + 1, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
+}
+
+void exchangeAndCompute(PersistentHaloExchange& exchange, const Real* input,
+                        Real* output, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                        const size_t lz, const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors) {
+    const size_t xBegin = neighbors[0] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t xEnd = neighbors[1] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lx + 1 : lx;
+    const size_t yBegin = neighbors[2] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t yEnd = neighbors[3] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? ly + 1 : ly;
+    const size_t zBegin = neighbors[4] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t zEnd = neighbors[5] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lz + 1 : lz;
+
+    exchange.start();
+    // This region has no halo dependency and overlaps network progress.
+    computeBlock(input, output, lx + 2, ly + 2, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
+                 zBegin, zEnd);
+    exchange.waitForReceives();
+    computeCoreComplement(input, output, lx, ly, lz, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
+                          zBegin, zEnd);
+    exchange.waitForSends();
+}
+
+void sendLarge(const Real* data, size_t count, const int destination, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
+    while (count != 0) {
+        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
+        MPI_Send(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, destination, 90, comm);
+        data += chunk;
+        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
+    }
+}
+
+void receiveLarge(Real* data, size_t count, const int source, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
+    while (count != 0) {
+        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
+        MPI_Recv(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, source, 90, comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
+        data += chunk;
+        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
+    }
+}

+std::vector<Real> packInterior(const Real* grid, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                               const size_t lz) {
+    std::vector<Real> packed(lx * ly * lz);
+    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+    size_t target = 0;
+    for (size_t z = 1; z <= lz; ++z) {
+        for (size_t y = 1; y <= ly; ++y) {
+            const Real* row = grid + idx3(1, y, z, sx, sy);
+            std::copy_n(row, lx, packed.data() + target);
+            target += lx;
+        }
+    }
+    return packed;
+}
+

+            std::copy_n(packed + source, xp.count, row);

         }
     }

+std::vector<Real> gatherGlobalGrid(const Real* localGrid, const Partition& xp,
+                                   const Partition& yp, const Partition& zp,
+                                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                   const size_t nz, const std::array<int, 3>& dims,
+                                   const int cartRank, const int cartSize,
+                                   MPI_Comm cartComm) {
+    std::vector<Real> packed = packInterior(localGrid, xp.count, yp.count, zp.count);
+    if (cartRank != 0) {
+        sendLarge(packed.data(), packed.size(), 0, cartComm);
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<Real> global(nx * ny * nz);
+    initializeGlobalGrid(global);
+    for (int source = 0; source < cartSize; ++source) {
+        std::array<int, 3> coords{};
+        MPI_Cart_coords(cartComm, source, 3, coords.data());
+        const Partition sourceX = makePartition(nx - 2, coords[0], dims[0]);
+        const Partition sourceY = makePartition(ny - 2, coords[1], dims[1]);
+        const Partition sourceZ = makePartition(nz - 2, coords[2], dims[2]);
+        const size_t sourceCount = sourceX.count * sourceY.count * sourceZ.count;
+
+        if (source == 0) {
+            unpackInterior(packed.data(), global, sourceX, sourceY, sourceZ, nx, ny);
+        } else {
+            std::vector<Real> received(sourceCount);
+            receiveLarge(received.data(), received.size(), source, cartComm);
+            unpackInterior(received.data(), global, sourceX, sourceY, sourceZ, nx, ny);
+        }
+    }
+    return global;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text[0] == '-') return false;
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+int parseArguments(const int argc, char** argv, Options& options, const bool report) {
+    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {

+            if (!parseSize(argv[++i], options.nx)) {
+                if (report) std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid X dimension: %s\n", argv[i]);

+                if (report) std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid iteration count: %s\n", argv[i]);

+        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {

+        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {

+        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
+            if (report) printUsage(argv[0]);

+                printUsage(argv[0]);
             }
+            return 1;
         }
     }

+    if (options.ny == 0) options.ny = options.nx;
+    if (options.nz == 0) options.nz = options.nx;

+size_t ceilDivide(const size_t value, const int parts) {
+    return value / static_cast<size_t>(parts) +
+           (value % static_cast<size_t>(parts) != 0 ? 1 : 0);

+// Pick the largest usable Cartesian grid, then favor balanced work and small
+// halo surfaces. Unlike MPI_Dims_create, this also respects anisotropic grids
+// and never creates an empty subdomain.
+ProcessGrid chooseProcessGrid(const int worldSize, const size_t ix,
+                              const size_t iy, const size_t iz) {
+    const size_t interiorCells = ix * iy * iz;
+    const int maximumRanks = interiorCells < static_cast<size_t>(worldSize)
+                                 ? static_cast<int>(interiorCells)
+                                 : worldSize;
+    for (int ranks = maximumRanks; ranks >= 1; --ranks) {
+        bool found = false;
+        std::array<int, 3> best{1, 1, 1};
+        size_t bestMaxCells = std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max();
+        long double bestSurface = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
+        long double bestTotalSurface = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
+
+        for (int px = 1; px <= ranks; ++px) {
+            if (ranks % px != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(px) > ix) continue;
+            const int yz = ranks / px;
+            for (int py = 1; py <= yz; ++py) {
+                if (yz % py != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(py) > iy) continue;
+                const int pz = yz / py;
+                if (static_cast<size_t>(pz) > iz) continue;
+
+                const size_t maxX = ceilDivide(ix, px);
+                const size_t maxY = ceilDivide(iy, py);
+                const size_t maxZ = ceilDivide(iz, pz);
+                const size_t maxCells = maxX * maxY * maxZ;
+                const long double surface =
+                    (px > 1 ? 2.0L * maxY * maxZ : 0.0L) +
+                    (py > 1 ? 2.0L * maxX * maxZ : 0.0L) +
+                    (pz > 1 ? 2.0L * maxX * maxY : 0.0L);
+                const long double totalSurface =
+                    static_cast<long double>(px - 1) * iy * iz +
+                    static_cast<long double>(py - 1) * ix * iz +
+                    static_cast<long double>(pz - 1) * ix * iy;
+
+                if (!found || maxCells < bestMaxCells ||
+                    (maxCells == bestMaxCells && surface < bestSurface) ||
+                    (maxCells == bestMaxCells && surface == bestSurface &&
+                     totalSurface < bestTotalSurface)) {
+                    found = true;
+                    best = {px, py, pz};
+                    bestMaxCells = maxCells;
+                    bestSurface = surface;
+                    bestTotalSurface = totalSurface;
+                }
             }
         }
+        if (found) return {ranks, best};

+Partition makePartition(const size_t interiorExtent, const int coordinate,
+                        const int processes) {
+    const size_t base = interiorExtent / static_cast<size_t>(processes);
+    const size_t remainder = interiorExtent % static_cast<size_t>(processes);
+    const size_t coord = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    const size_t count = base + (coord < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const size_t offset = coord * base + std::min(coord, remainder);
+    return {offset + 1, count};
+}

+class PersistentHaloExchange {
+  public:
+    PersistentHaloExchange(Real* data, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                           const size_t lz, const FaceTypes& faces,
+                           const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors, MPI_Comm comm) {
+        const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+        const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+        const auto at = [sx, sy](const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {
+            return idx3(x, y, z, sx, sy);
+        };
+        const auto receive = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
+                                 const int neighbor, const int tag) {
+            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_Recv_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
+                              &receives_[receiveCount_++]);
+            }
+        };
+        const auto send = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
+                              const int neighbor, const int tag) {
+            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_Send_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
+                              &sends_[sendCount_++]);
+            }
+        };
+
+        // Receive requests are kept separate so computation can resume as soon
+        // as incoming halos arrive, without waiting for outgoing sends.
+        receive(data + at(0, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(lx + 1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_MINUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 0, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, ly + 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_MINUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 1, 0), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 1, lz + 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_MINUS);
+
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(lx, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_PLUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(1, ly, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_PLUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, lz), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_PLUS);
+    }
+
+    PersistentHaloExchange(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
+    PersistentHaloExchange& operator=(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
+
+    ~PersistentHaloExchange() {
+        for (int i = 0; i < receiveCount_; ++i) {
+            MPI_Request_free(&receives_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
+        }
+        for (int i = 0; i < sendCount_; ++i) {
+            MPI_Request_free(&sends_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void start() {
+        if (receiveCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(receiveCount_, receives_.data());
+        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(sendCount_, sends_.data());
+    }
+
+    void waitForReceives() {
+        if (receiveCount_ != 0) {
+            MPI_Waitall(receiveCount_, receives_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void waitForSends() {
+        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Waitall(sendCount_, sends_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+
+  private:
+    static constexpr int X_TO_MINUS = 10;
+    static constexpr int X_TO_PLUS = 11;
+    static constexpr int Y_TO_MINUS = 12;
+    static constexpr int Y_TO_PLUS = 13;
+    static constexpr int Z_TO_MINUS = 14;
+    static constexpr int Z_TO_PLUS = 15;
+
+    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> receives_{};
+    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> sends_{};
+    int receiveCount_ = 0;
+    int sendCount_ = 0;
+};

+inline void computeBlock(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
+                         Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t sx,
+                         const size_t sy, const size_t xBegin, const size_t xEnd,
+                         const size_t yBegin, const size_t yEnd,
+                         const size_t zBegin, const size_t zEnd) {
+    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) return;
+    const size_t plane = sx * sy;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        for (size_t y = yBegin; y < yEnd; ++y) {
+            const size_t rowStart = idx3(xBegin, y, z, sx, sy);
+            const size_t rowEnd = rowStart + (xEnd - xBegin);
+#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
+#pragma GCC ivdep
+#endif
+            for (size_t i = rowStart; i < rowEnd; ++i) {
+                output[i] = (input[i] + input[i - 1] + input[i + 1] +
+                             input[i - sx] + input[i + sx] + input[i - plane] +
+                             input[i + plane]) /
+                            7.0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Compute the complement of an already-computed rectangular core. The six
+// blocks are disjoint. On ranks at a physical boundary, the core extends to
+// that boundary because its fixed halo is already available.
+void computeCoreComplement(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
+                           Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t lx,
+                           const size_t ly, const size_t lz, const size_t xBegin,
+                           const size_t xEnd, const size_t yBegin,
+                           const size_t yEnd, const size_t zBegin,
+                           const size_t zEnd) {
+    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, lz + 1);
+        return;
+    }
+
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, zBegin);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, zEnd, lz + 1);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, yBegin, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, yEnd, ly + 1, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, xBegin, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, xEnd, lx + 1, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
+}
+
+void exchangeAndCompute(PersistentHaloExchange& exchange, const Real* input,
+                        Real* output, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                        const size_t lz, const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors) {
+    const size_t xBegin = neighbors[0] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t xEnd = neighbors[1] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lx + 1 : lx;
+    const size_t yBegin = neighbors[2] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t yEnd = neighbors[3] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? ly + 1 : ly;
+    const size_t zBegin = neighbors[4] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t zEnd = neighbors[5] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lz + 1 : lz;
+
+    exchange.start();
+    // This region has no halo dependency and overlaps network progress.
+    computeBlock(input, output, lx + 2, ly + 2, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
+                 zBegin, zEnd);
+    exchange.waitForReceives();
+    computeCoreComplement(input, output, lx, ly, lz, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
+                          zBegin, zEnd);
+    exchange.waitForSends();
+}

+void sendLarge(const Real* data, size_t count, const int destination, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
+    while (count != 0) {
+        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
+        MPI_Send(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, destination, 90, comm);
+        data += chunk;
+        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
+    }
+}
+
+void receiveLarge(Real* data, size_t count, const int source, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
+    while (count != 0) {
+        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
+        MPI_Recv(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, source, 90, comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
+        data += chunk;
+        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
+    }
+}

+std::vector<Real> packInterior(const Real* grid, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                               const size_t lz) {
+    std::vector<Real> packed(lx * ly * lz);
+    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+    size_t target = 0;
+    for (size_t z = 1; z <= lz; ++z) {
+        for (size_t y = 1; y <= ly; ++y) {
+            const Real* row = grid + idx3(1, y, z, sx, sy);
+            std::copy_n(row, lx, packed.data() + target);
+            target += lx;
+        }
+    }
+    return packed;
+}

+std::vector<Real> gatherGlobalGrid(const Real* localGrid, const Partition& xp,
+                                   const Partition& yp, const Partition& zp,
+                                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                   const size_t nz, const std::array<int, 3>& dims,
+                                   const int cartRank, const int cartSize,
+                                   MPI_Comm cartComm) {
+    std::vector<Real> packed = packInterior(localGrid, xp.count, yp.count, zp.count);
+    if (cartRank != 0) {
+        sendLarge(packed.data(), packed.size(), 0, cartComm);
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<Real> global(nx * ny * nz);
+    initializeGlobalGrid(global);
+    for (int source = 0; source < cartSize; ++source) {
+        std::array<int, 3> coords{};
+        MPI_Cart_coords(cartComm, source, 3, coords.data());
+        const Partition sourceX = makePartition(nx - 2, coords[0], dims[0]);
+        const Partition sourceY = makePartition(ny - 2, coords[1], dims[1]);
+        const Partition sourceZ = makePartition(nz - 2, coords[2], dims[2]);
+        const size_t sourceCount = sourceX.count * sourceY.count * sourceZ.count;
+
+        if (source == 0) {
+            unpackInterior(packed.data(), global, sourceX, sourceY, sourceZ, nx, ny);
+        } else {
+            std::vector<Real> received(sourceCount);
+            receiveLarge(received.data(), received.size(), source, cartComm);
+            unpackInterior(received.data(), global, sourceX, sourceY, sourceZ, nx, ny);
+        }
+    }
+    return global;

codex
Implemented MPI distributed-memory parallelization while preserving serial semantics.

Key changes:

- 3D Cartesian domain decomposition with balanced, nonempty subdomains.
- Persistent nonblocking six-face halo exchanges.
- Communication/computation overlap and vectorizable stencil loops.
- Fixed global boundary behavior matching the original.
- Distributed validation; full-grid gathering only for `-r`.
- Root-only reporting and maximum-rank timing.
- CMake now requires and links MPI; executable remains `stencil3d`.

+        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
+            options.printResults = true;
+        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
+            if (report) printUsage(argv[0]);
+            return 2;
+        } else {
+            if (report) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Unknown or incomplete option: %s\n", argv[i]);
+                printUsage(argv[0]);
             }
+            return 1;
         }

+    if (options.nz == 0) options.nz = options.nx;

+size_t ceilDivide(const size_t value, const int parts) {
+    return value / static_cast<size_t>(parts) +
+           (value % static_cast<size_t>(parts) != 0 ? 1 : 0);
+}

+// Pick the largest usable Cartesian grid, then favor balanced work and small
+// halo surfaces. Unlike MPI_Dims_create, this also respects anisotropic grids
+// and never creates an empty subdomain.
+ProcessGrid chooseProcessGrid(const int worldSize, const size_t ix,
+                              const size_t iy, const size_t iz) {
+    const size_t interiorCells = ix * iy * iz;
+    const int maximumRanks = interiorCells < static_cast<size_t>(worldSize)
+                                 ? static_cast<int>(interiorCells)
+                                 : worldSize;
+    for (int ranks = maximumRanks; ranks >= 1; --ranks) {
+        bool found = false;
+        std::array<int, 3> best{1, 1, 1};
+        size_t bestMaxCells = std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max();
+        long double bestSurface = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
+        long double bestTotalSurface = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
+
+        for (int px = 1; px <= ranks; ++px) {
+            if (ranks % px != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(px) > ix) continue;
+            const int yz = ranks / px;
+            for (int py = 1; py <= yz; ++py) {
+                if (yz % py != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(py) > iy) continue;
+                const int pz = yz / py;
+                if (static_cast<size_t>(pz) > iz) continue;
+
+                const size_t maxX = ceilDivide(ix, px);
+                const size_t maxY = ceilDivide(iy, py);
+                const size_t maxZ = ceilDivide(iz, pz);
+                const size_t maxCells = maxX * maxY * maxZ;
+                const long double surface =
+                    (px > 1 ? 2.0L * maxY * maxZ : 0.0L) +
+                    (py > 1 ? 2.0L * maxX * maxZ : 0.0L) +
+                    (pz > 1 ? 2.0L * maxX * maxY : 0.0L);
+                const long double totalSurface =
+                    static_cast<long double>(px - 1) * iy * iz +
+                    static_cast<long double>(py - 1) * ix * iz +
+                    static_cast<long double>(pz - 1) * ix * iy;
+
+                if (!found || maxCells < bestMaxCells ||
+                    (maxCells == bestMaxCells && surface < bestSurface) ||
+                    (maxCells == bestMaxCells && surface == bestSurface &&
+                     totalSurface < bestTotalSurface)) {
+                    found = true;
+                    best = {px, py, pz};
+                    bestMaxCells = maxCells;
+                    bestSurface = surface;
+                    bestTotalSurface = totalSurface;
+                }
             }
         }
+        if (found) return {ranks, best};
     }

+Partition makePartition(const size_t interiorExtent, const int coordinate,
+                        const int processes) {
+    const size_t base = interiorExtent / static_cast<size_t>(processes);
+    const size_t remainder = interiorExtent % static_cast<size_t>(processes);
+    const size_t coord = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    const size_t count = base + (coord < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const size_t offset = coord * base + std::min(coord, remainder);
+    return {offset + 1, count};
+}

+void initializeGlobalGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid) {
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < grid.size(); ++i) grid[i] = static_cast<Real>(i % 19);

+                grid[idx3(x, y, z, sx, sy)] = static_cast<Real>(globalIndex % 19);

+class FaceTypes {

+class PersistentHaloExchange {
+  public:
+    PersistentHaloExchange(Real* data, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                           const size_t lz, const FaceTypes& faces,
+                           const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors, MPI_Comm comm) {
+        const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+        const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+        const auto at = [sx, sy](const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {
+            return idx3(x, y, z, sx, sy);
+        };
+        const auto receive = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
+                                 const int neighbor, const int tag) {
+            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_Recv_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
+                              &receives_[receiveCount_++]);
+            }
+        };
+        const auto send = [&](Real* buffer, const MPI_Datatype type,
+                              const int neighbor, const int tag) {
+            if (neighbor != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_Send_init(buffer, 1, type, neighbor, tag, comm,
+                              &sends_[sendCount_++]);
+            }
+        };
+
+        // Receive requests are kept separate so computation can resume as soon
+        // as incoming halos arrive, without waiting for outgoing sends.
+        receive(data + at(0, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(lx + 1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_MINUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 0, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, ly + 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_MINUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 1, 0), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_PLUS);
+        receive(data + at(1, 1, lz + 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_MINUS);
+
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[0], X_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(lx, 1, 1), faces.xFace, neighbors[1], X_TO_PLUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[2], Y_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(1, ly, 1), faces.yFace, neighbors[3], Y_TO_PLUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, 1), faces.zFace, neighbors[4], Z_TO_MINUS);
+        send(data + at(1, 1, lz), faces.zFace, neighbors[5], Z_TO_PLUS);
+    }
+
+    PersistentHaloExchange(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
+    PersistentHaloExchange& operator=(const PersistentHaloExchange&) = delete;
+
+    ~PersistentHaloExchange() {
+        for (int i = 0; i < receiveCount_; ++i) {
+            MPI_Request_free(&receives_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
+        }
+        for (int i = 0; i < sendCount_; ++i) {
+            MPI_Request_free(&sends_[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void start() {
+        if (receiveCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(receiveCount_, receives_.data());
+        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Startall(sendCount_, sends_.data());
+    }
+
+    void waitForReceives() {
+        if (receiveCount_ != 0) {
+            MPI_Waitall(receiveCount_, receives_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void waitForSends() {
+        if (sendCount_ != 0) MPI_Waitall(sendCount_, sends_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+
+  private:
+    static constexpr int X_TO_MINUS = 10;
+    static constexpr int X_TO_PLUS = 11;
+    static constexpr int Y_TO_MINUS = 12;
+    static constexpr int Y_TO_PLUS = 13;
+    static constexpr int Z_TO_MINUS = 14;
+    static constexpr int Z_TO_PLUS = 15;
+
+    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> receives_{};
+    std::array<MPI_Request, 6> sends_{};
+    int receiveCount_ = 0;
+    int sendCount_ = 0;
+};
+
+inline void computeBlock(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
+                         Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t sx,
+                         const size_t sy, const size_t xBegin, const size_t xEnd,
+                         const size_t yBegin, const size_t yEnd,
+                         const size_t zBegin, const size_t zEnd) {
+    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) return;
+    const size_t plane = sx * sy;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        for (size_t y = yBegin; y < yEnd; ++y) {
+            const size_t rowStart = idx3(xBegin, y, z, sx, sy);
+            const size_t rowEnd = rowStart + (xEnd - xBegin);
+#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
+#pragma GCC ivdep
+#endif
+            for (size_t i = rowStart; i < rowEnd; ++i) {
+                output[i] = (input[i] + input[i - 1] + input[i + 1] +
+                             input[i - sx] + input[i + sx] + input[i - plane] +
+                             input[i + plane]) /
+                            7.0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Compute the complement of an already-computed rectangular core. The six
+// blocks are disjoint. On ranks at a physical boundary, the core extends to
+// that boundary because its fixed halo is already available.
+void computeCoreComplement(const Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT input,
+                           Real* STENCIL_RESTRICT output, const size_t lx,
+                           const size_t ly, const size_t lz, const size_t xBegin,
+                           const size_t xEnd, const size_t yBegin,
+                           const size_t yEnd, const size_t zBegin,
+                           const size_t zEnd) {
+    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+    if (xBegin >= xEnd || yBegin >= yEnd || zBegin >= zEnd) {
+        computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, lz + 1);
+        return;
+    }
+
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, 1, zBegin);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, ly + 1, zEnd, lz + 1);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, 1, yBegin, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, lx + 1, yEnd, ly + 1, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, 1, xBegin, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
+    computeBlock(input, output, sx, sy, xEnd, lx + 1, yBegin, yEnd, zBegin, zEnd);
+}
+
+void exchangeAndCompute(PersistentHaloExchange& exchange, const Real* input,
+                        Real* output, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                        const size_t lz, const std::array<int, 6>& neighbors) {
+    const size_t xBegin = neighbors[0] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t xEnd = neighbors[1] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lx + 1 : lx;
+    const size_t yBegin = neighbors[2] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t yEnd = neighbors[3] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? ly + 1 : ly;
+    const size_t zBegin = neighbors[4] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? 1 : 2;
+    const size_t zEnd = neighbors[5] == MPI_PROC_NULL ? lz + 1 : lz;
+
+    exchange.start();
+    // This region has no halo dependency and overlaps network progress.
+    computeBlock(input, output, lx + 2, ly + 2, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
+                 zBegin, zEnd);
+    exchange.waitForReceives();
+    computeCoreComplement(input, output, lx, ly, lz, xBegin, xEnd, yBegin, yEnd,
+                          zBegin, zEnd);
+    exchange.waitForSends();
+}

+void sendLarge(const Real* data, size_t count, const int destination, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
+    while (count != 0) {
+        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
+        MPI_Send(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, destination, 90, comm);
+        data += chunk;
+        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
+    }
+}
+
+void receiveLarge(Real* data, size_t count, const int source, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    constexpr size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;
+    while (count != 0) {
+        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min(count, chunkSize));
+        MPI_Recv(data, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, source, 90, comm, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
+        data += chunk;
+        count -= static_cast<size_t>(chunk);
+    }
+}

+std::vector<Real> packInterior(const Real* grid, const size_t lx, const size_t ly,
+                               const size_t lz) {
+    std::vector<Real> packed(lx * ly * lz);
+    const size_t sx = lx + 2;
+    const size_t sy = ly + 2;
+    size_t target = 0;
+    for (size_t z = 1; z <= lz; ++z) {
+        for (size_t y = 1; y <= ly; ++y) {
+            const Real* row = grid + idx3(1, y, z, sx, sy);
+            std::copy_n(row, lx, packed.data() + target);
+            target += lx;
+        }
+    }
+    return packed;
+}

+std::vector<Real> gatherGlobalGrid(const Real* localGrid, const Partition& xp,
+                                   const Partition& yp, const Partition& zp,
+                                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                   const size_t nz, const std::array<int, 3>& dims,
+                                   const int cartRank, const int cartSize,
+                                   MPI_Comm cartComm) {
+    std::vector<Real> packed = packInterior(localGrid, xp.count, yp.count, zp.count);
+    if (cartRank != 0) {
+        sendLarge(packed.data(), packed.size(), 0, cartComm);
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<Real> global(nx * ny * nz);
+    initializeGlobalGrid(global);
+    for (int source = 0; source < cartSize; ++source) {
+        std::array<int, 3> coords{};
+        MPI_Cart_coords(cartComm, source, 3, coords.data());
+        const Partition sourceX = makePartition(nx - 2, coords[0], dims[0]);
+        const Partition sourceY = makePartition(ny - 2, coords[1], dims[1]);
+        const Partition sourceZ = makePartition(nz - 2, coords[2], dims[2]);
+        const size_t sourceCount = sourceX.count * sourceY.count * sourceZ.count;
+
+        if (source == 0) {
+            unpackInterior(packed.data(), global, sourceX, sourceY, sourceZ, nx, ny);
+        } else {
+            std::vector<Real> received(sourceCount);
+            receiveLarge(received.data(), received.size(), source, cartComm);
+            unpackInterior(received.data(), global, sourceX, sourceY, sourceZ, nx, ny);
+        }
+    }
+    return global;
+}
